name: VowelRotatorAndConsonantPreserver

description_json.name: Vowel Rotator and Consonant Preserver
description_json.idea: To ensure absolute implementation correctness and high reasoning capability, this cipher only modifies vowels (a, e, i, o, u) by rotating them forward to the next vowel in the sequence, while leaving all consonants, digits, spaces, and punctuation completely unchanged. Case is preserved.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Identify all vowels (a, e, i, o, u, and their uppercase equivalents A, E, I, O, U). Replace each vowel with the next vowel in the circular sequence: 'a' -> 'e', 'e' -> 'i', 'i' -> 'o', 'o' -> 'u', 'u' -> 'a'. For uppercase: 'A' -> 'E', 'E' -> 'I', 'I' -> 'O', 'O' -> 'U', 'U' -> 'A'. All other characters (consonants, spaces, punctuation, digits) remain exactly the same.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Identify all vowels (a, e, i, o, u, and their uppercase equivalents A, E, I, O, U). Replace each vowel with the previous vowel in the circular sequence: 'a' -> 'u', 'e' -> 'a', 'i' -> 'e', 'o' -> 'i', 'u' -> 'o'. For uppercase: 'A' -> 'U', 'E' -> 'A', 'I' -> 'E', 'O' -> 'I', 'U' -> 'O'. All other characters remain exactly the same.

example.plaintext: Hello World! This is a test.
example.ciphertext: Hillu Wurld! Thas os e tist.
